description: Free up your hands and prevent tool damage with the Freeman PSTHSF 1" Aluminum Pneumatic Tool Hook with 1/4" Straight Industrial Fitting. The lightweight hanger is constructed of a durable anodized aluminum, and is compatible with any brand or type of pneumatic tool with a 1/4" NPT inlet. This adjustable hook rotates to either side of your tool so you can easily use it whether you are right or left handed or just need to be able to hang your tool anywhere. A 1/4" NPT straight industrial fitting is included. The L-shaped design is 4" long and gives 1" clearance from the tool to easily hang on tool belts or pockets, ensuring your tool is safe while climbing ladders, positioning materials, or moving around the jobsite.
